plan.title: fix(doctor): fail closed on xBRIEF envelope major version mismatch

narratives.Description: Doctor can leave operators without a hard fail when project xBRIEF envelopes declare an older major than the installed framework. Epic #3237 Q5 Option 2 limits the first deposit ship to envelope major mismatch only.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator on a hybrid-migrated consumer, I want doctor to fail closed when project envelope major is behind the framework major, so that I am not left with a green session while migrate/version drift remains.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Strengthen the xbrief-envelope-version (or equivalent) check in packages/core/src/doctor so declared envelope major behind framework major fails closed with declared vs expected versions and migrate/upgrade remediation. Align with packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate for #3236 rewrite path messaging. Do not implement missing-file inventory or full compatibility manifest. Tests under packages/core/src/doctor. Run vitest and task check. Cite #3243 in CHANGELOG.md.
narratives.Overview: fix(doctor): fail closed on xBRIEF envelope major version mismatch
narratives.NonGoals: Out of issue scope; see epic #3237 current-shape.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Acceptance items from locked epic contracts.

narrative.Acceptance: Given lifecycle artifacts declaring xBRIEFInfo.version major 0.6 while framework expects 0.8, when doctor runs, the envelope-major check fails closed with both versions named.
Given all scanned envelopes at the framework major, when doctor runs, this check does not fail for major mismatch.
Given CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased], when the PR lands, it cites #3243.

verify_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/doctor packages/core/src/vbrief-validate
swarm.acceptance_criteria_justification: Items map to locked contracts / issue AC.
